title: Mother and Daughter by Fireplace, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-century black-and-white home interior snapshot depicting a woman named Harriet leaning against an ornate fireplace mantel while holding a young girl named Honey close to her side. The room features formal wall paneling, a detailed chinoiserie-style mirror frame, a radiator, and matching table lamps carefully preserved in protective plastic coverings, reflecting post-WWII domestic home care aesthetics.
